title: Plasma-Echo-Constrained Kinetic Memory: A Mori–Zwanzig Memory Test for Separating Reversible Phase Mixing from Collisional Loss
description: Preprint v1.0. Numerical Vlasov–Poisson study: Landau damping validation, two-pulse plasma echo, collisional suppression, and a delay-embedding memory test against a memoryless closure. No experimental or observational claim.
notes: Metadata prepared for a future deposit. No Zenodo deposit has been made.
